**Stable ID:** `DATA-04.01` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 04 Dataset identity, versions and relationships

Define stable internal dataset IDs and how external identifiers, publishers and hosts are recorded.

## Deliverables

- Identifier scheme for datasets, versions and subsets
- Publisher, maintainer and host fields

## Canonical artifact paths

- `schemas/dataset-record.schema.json`
- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- External identifiers are recorded exactly as issued, with issuer and kind

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Internal IDs are namespaced and independent of titles
- [ ] DOI, host IDs and paper IDs are not interchangeable
- [ ] Validator rejects duplicate canonical IDs

## Non-goals

- Minting external DOIs

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-04.01.T1` Define identifiers
  - [ ] `DATA-04.01.T1.S1` Define the internal ID format
  - [ ] `DATA-04.01.T1.S2` Define external identifier kinds and issuers
  - [ ] `DATA-04.01.T1.S3` Define publisher versus host versus maintainer
- [ ] `DATA-04.01.T2` Encode
  - [ ] `DATA-04.01.T2.S1` Write the record schema
  - [ ] `DATA-04.01.T2.S2` Add uniqueness validation
  - [ ] `DATA-04.01.T2.S3` Add fixtures and tests
